name: Nous Portal
summary: Nous Portal is Nous Research's account layer for Hermes Agent: one sign-in gives access to a model catalog, a tool gateway and cloud hosting. Models and hosted tools (web search, scraping, image generation, browser automation, speech) draw from one credit balance. Paid tiers are monthly subscriptions that include credits.
facts: Web search, scraping, image generation, browser automation, speech; billed per use
Free (free models only); Plus $20, Super $100, Ultra $200 per month with included credits
Connect an eligible ChatGPT plan for supported inference
goodFor: Hermes Agent users wanting one account for models and tools
Bundling hosted tools with model credits
watchOut: Built around Hermes Agent rather than as a general gateway
Credit rollover is capped per tier
